description: Typed model admission policy — PASS cases (redistributable auto-admit, restricted with valid record)

test_cases.name: licence::tests::redistributable_admits_without_record
test_cases.notes: Redistributable models (MIT, Apache-2.0, self-trained) admit on hash/provenance alone

test_cases.name: licence::tests::restricted_admits_with_matching_record
test_cases.notes: Restricted models require explicit acceptance record with matching licence_sha256

test_cases.name: licence::tests::restricted_atomic_write_with_explicit_accept
test_cases.expected: Ok — record written, .tmp cleaned up, final file parses
test_cases.notes: Atomic write (temp + rename) ensures truncated records never masquerade as valid

test_cases.name: licence::tests::restricted_write_then_admit_roundtrip
test_cases.notes: Full round-trip: denied without record, admitted after write_acceptance_record

test_cases.name: licence::tests::restricted_existing_record_is_idempotent
test_cases.notes: Idempotent check — no writes, no env var, no side effects

test_cases.name: models::tests::manifest_validate_ok_offline_cache
test_cases.expected: Ok — validates against manifest without licence record
test_cases.notes: Redistributable model with matching sha256, no licence.accepted needed

test_cases.name: models::tests::manifest_validate_redistributable_no_record_succeeds
test_cases.notes: Explicit test: no record, no env var, redistributable admits

test_cases.name: models::tests::manifest_validate_allows_restricted_with_authorisation
test_cases.expected: Ok — restricted model with record + authorisation
test_cases.notes: Restricted model passes both admission gate (record) and authorisation gate (allow_restricted)

fake_acceptance_records: pre-written licence.accepted files from PKGBUILD/install scripts are no longer required for redistributable models — they become dead artifacts. Removal from packaging scripts is Task 4's follow-up.
